cases.name: exact_unicode

history.content: The Durnhaven conservator Maël keeps 58 violet seals.
I have that as your note for the conservator.
Use that count for this draft.

cases.question: How many violet seals does Maël keep in this draft?
cases.expected: 58; do not change the count or invent a different source.

cases.name: unaccepted_proposal

history.content: We are brainstorming a harbor scene. No final choice for the keeper's coat color.
One possibility is a cobalt coat.
Maybe. Keep cobalt as an option; I have not chosen a color.

cases.question: Which coat color did I decide on?
cases.expected: No final decision; cobalt is an option, not an accepted choice.

cases.name: rejected_plan

history.content: For this draft, Lena should leave by ferry.
The departure scene can take place on the ferry.
Change that: she takes the night train. The ferry plan is abandoned.

cases.question: Continue planning the departure. Which transport should we use, and which plan did we discard?
cases.expected: Use night train; ferry was abandoned. New proposals must not be presented as prior decisions.

cases.name: resume_open_work

history.content: For the tower scene keep the narrator unreliable. Do not resolve whether the bell was really heard.
Next we can draft the staircase scene while leaving the bell ambiguous.
Yes. Next write the staircase scene. We still need to choose whether Lena or Oren is narrating.

cases.question: Where did we leave off: what is next, what remains undecided, and what constraint must remain?
cases.expected: Next staircase scene; narrator Lena or Oren undecided; preserve unreliability and deliberate bell ambiguity. No invented prior scene facts.

cases.name: deliberate_ambiguity

history.content: There are two accounts of the fire: Mira says the lamp fell; Oren says someone pushed it.
We could reveal who is lying later.
Do not settle who is lying. Both accounts must remain plausible in this draft.

cases.question: What caused the fire in our current draft?
cases.expected: Cause deliberately unresolved; retain fallen-versus-pushed accounts without choosing a cause or treating resolution as a pending obligation.

cases.name: partial_evidence

history.content: This excerpt covers the harbor at dawn. We have not searched the full manuscript.
These notes alone do not cover every chapter.
Only these notes are available for this question.

cases.question: Does a silver astrolabe appear anywhere else in the whole manuscript?
cases.expected: Cannot determine from these partial notes. Do not assert whole-manuscript absence or pretend to have searched it.

cases.name: current_override

history.content: Usually I like my letters terse.
I can use terse language as a default for letters.
That is just a default, not a rule against changing style.

cases.question: For this letter I want a warm, expansive style. Draft two sentences thanking my mentor. Do not force it terse.
cases.expected: Draft two warm sentences honoring the current request, not a terse-style refusal. Do not fabricate remembered personal history.
